condition_item_mode.description: What to check about the user.

condition_item_value.description: User ID for equal and not_equal, role ID for has_role and not_has_role, or permission bitfield for has_permission and not_has_permission.

control_condition_channel.title: Channel Condition
control_condition_channel.description: Run actions based on a channel.

custom_label.description: Label shown on the block in the editor instead of its default title. It has no effect on what the flow does.

condition_base_value.description: ID of the channel that each branch checks.

condition_allow_multiple.description: Whether every matching branch runs. If unset, only the first matching branch runs.

control_condition_item_channel.title: Match Channel
control_condition_item_channel.description: Run actions if the channel meets the criteria.

custom_label.description: Label shown on the block in the editor instead of its default title. It has no effect on what the flow does.

condition_item_mode.description: Whether the base value has to match this branch's value.

condition_item_value.description: ID to compare the base value with.

control_condition_role.title: Role Condition
control_condition_role.description: Run actions based on a role.

custom_label.description: Label shown on the block in the editor instead of its default title. It has no effect on what the flow does.

condition_base_value.description: ID of the role that each branch checks.

condition_allow_multiple.description: Whether every matching branch runs. If unset, only the first matching branch runs.

control_condition_item_role.title: Match Role
control_condition_item_role.description: Run actions if the role meets the criteria.

custom_label.description: Label shown on the block in the editor instead of its default title. It has no effect on what the flow does.

condition_item_mode.description: Whether the base value has to match this branch's value.

condition_item_value.description: ID to compare the base value with.

control_condition_item_else.title: Else
control_condition_item_else.description: Run actions if no other conditions are met.

control_error_handler.title: Handle Errors
control_error_handler.description: Handle errors that occur in the flow after this block.

custom_label.description: Label shown on the block in the editor instead of its default title. It has no effect on what the flow does.

temporary_name.description: Stores the result of this block in a temporary variable that later blocks can read with {{var('name')}}. Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only.

control_loop.title: Run a loop
control_loop.description: Run a set of actions multiple times.

custom_label.description: Label shown on the block in the editor instead of its default title. It has no effect on what the flow does.

loop_count.description: How many times the loop runs.

control_loop_each.title: Each loop iteration
control_loop_each.description: Run actions for each iteration of the loop.

control_loop_end.title: After loop
control_loop_end.description: Run actions after the loop has finished.

control_sleep.title: Wait
control_sleep.description: Pause the flow for a set amount of time.

custom_label.description: Label shown on the block in the editor instead of its default title. It has no effect on what the flow does.

sleep_duration_seconds.description: How many seconds to wait before continuing.

custom_label.description: Label shown on the block in the editor instead of its default title. It has no effect on what the flow does.

name.description: Name of the argument. Its value can be read with {{arg('name')}}.

description.description: Description of the argument shown in Discord.

command_argument_type.description: Type of value the user has to enter.

command_argument_required.description: Whether the user has to fill in the argument.

command_argument_min_value.description: Smallest allowed value for integer and number arguments.

command_argument_max_value.description: Largest allowed value for integer and number arguments.

value.description: Value the flow receives when the choice is picked.

command_argument_choices.description: Fixed choices the user picks from, for string and integer arguments. Choices with an empty name or value are ignored.

option_command_permissions.title: Command Permissions
option_command_permissions.description: Make the command only available to users with the specified permissions.

custom_label.description: Label shown on the block in the editor instead of its default title. It has no effect on what the flow does.

command_permissions.description: Discord permission bitfield. Only members with all of these permissions can see and use the command.

option_command_contexts.title: Command Contexts
option_command_contexts.description: Define where your command should be available. By default, it will be available everywhere.

custom_label.description: Label shown on the block in the editor instead of its default title. It has no effect on what the flow does.

command_disabled_contexts.description: Places where the command can't be used: servers, DMs with the bot, or other DMs and group DMs.

command_disabled_integrations.description: Install types the command isn't available for: installed to a server, or installed to a user.

option_event_filter.title: Event Filter
option_event_filter.description: Filter events based on their properties.

custom_label.description: Label shown on the block in the editor instead of its default title. It has no effect on what the flow does.

event_filter_target.description: Property of the event to filter on.

event_filter_mode.description: How the property is compared to the filter value.

event_filter_value.description: Value to compare against. This is fixed text, placeholders aren't supported.

suspend_response_modal.title: Show Modal
suspend_response_modal.description: Show a modal to the user and suspend the flow until the user submits the modal.

custom_label.description: Label shown on the block in the editor instead of its default title. It has no effect on what the flow does.

custom_id.description: Identifier of the input. The submitted value can be read with {{input('custom_id')}}. This is fixed text, placeholders aren't supported.

style.description: 1 for a single line input, 2 for a paragraph.

required.description: Whether the input has to be filled in.

min_length.description: Minimum length of the entered text.

max_length.description: Maximum length of the entered text.

value.description: Value the input is pre-filled with.

placeholder.description: Text shown while the input is empty.

components.description: The text input of the row.
Rows of the modal, each holding one text input.
